tracks.title: Public skills: investigate, test first, verify
expectedFailures: learner regressions catch the original bug

publicSkills.name: systematic-debugging
publicSkills.job: Replace speculative fixes with a reproduced root cause.
publicSkills.prompt: /systematic-debugging Read BRIEF.md and src/cart.mjs. Reproduce the quantity defect, cite file:line evidence, and state one testable cause. Do not edit yet. Keep investigation inside this disposable workspace.

publicSkills.name: test-driven-development
publicSkills.job: Make a regression fail for the right reason before repairing code.
publicSkills.prompt: /test-driven-development Follow BRIEF.md. Add at least four node:test cases to src/cart.test.mjs. Preserve existing behavior and cover quantity, invalid input and overflow. Run npm test with cart.mjs unchanged; stop for review of the red output. Do not delete existing starter or learner work.

publicSkills.name: verification-before-completion
publicSkills.job: Replace a confident completion claim with fresh terminal evidence.
publicSkills.prompt: /verification-before-completion Run npm test and npm run check now. Report actual exit codes, passed/failed counts and unresolved issues. Inspect git diff and git status --short, including untracked tests. Do not commit or change acceptance tooling.

recipes.name: explain
recipes.job: Ground the explanation in actual code, not invented helpers.
recipes.prompt: /explain Read BRIEF.md and src/cart.mjs. Explain the quantity bug with file:line evidence. List the existing API and unknowns. Do not edit files.

recipes.name: plan
recipes.job: Agree on scope and a red-to-green test plan before edits.
recipes.prompt: /plan Read BRIEF.md. Propose the smallest cart repair. Only src/cart.mjs and src/cart.test.mjs may change. Cite the root cause and propose boundary tests. Do not implement yet.

recipes.name: tests
recipes.job: Write tests that actually fail on the defective starter.
recipes.prompt: /tests Add at least four node:test cases to src/cart.test.mjs, importing ./cart.mjs. Cover existing behavior, quantity greater than one, invalid input and safe integer cents. Do not change src/cart.mjs. Run npm test and report the observed failures.

recipes.name: fix
recipes.job: Repair the cause without weakening tests or rewriting unrelated code.
recipes.prompt: /fix Repair src/cart.mjs against BRIEF.md and the failing tests. Keep its public API and src/legacy-pricing.mjs unchanged. No dependencies. Run npm test and npm run check; report both exit codes and any unresolved issue.

recipes.name: review
recipes.job: Review the actual change rather than trusting the author's summary.

recipes.name: rubber-duck
recipes.job: Challenge the proposed fix and its boundary assumptions.
recipes.prompt: /rubber-duck Challenge the cart repair against BRIEF.md. Look for missed boundaries, tests that also pass on the original implementation, and out-of-scope changes. Do not edit.

recipes.name: context
recipes.job: Inspect context usage before a long session loses focus.

recipes.name: compact
recipes.job: Reduce conversation size, then reattach the brief and test evidence.
